fr.sorbonne_u.components.hem2026e1.equipments.heater

Interface HeaterConfigurationI

  • All Known Subinterfaces:
    HeaterExternalControlCI, HeaterExternalControlI, HeaterExternalControlJava4CI, HeaterInternalControlCI, HeaterInternalControlI, HeaterStateI, HeaterUserCI, HeaterUserI, HeaterUserJava4CI
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    Heater, HeaterExternalControlConnector, HeaterExternalControlInboundPort, HeaterExternalControlJava4InboundPort, HeaterExternalControlOutboundPort, HeaterInternalControlConnector, HeaterInternalControlInboundPort, HeaterInternalControlOutboundPort, HeaterUserConnector, HeaterUserInboundPort, HeaterUserJava4InboundPort, HeaterUserOutboundPort

    public interface HeaterConfigurationI
    The interface HeaterConfigurationI defines configuration information for the heater component.

    Description

    Invariants

     invariant       TEMPERATURE_UNIT != null
 invariant       MIN_TARGET_TEMPERATURE != null && MIN_TARGET_TEMPERATURE.getMeasurementUnit().equals(TEMPERATURE_UNIT)
 invariant       MAX_TARGET_TEMPERATURE != null && MAX_TARGET_TEMPERATURE.getMeasurementUnit().equals(TEMPERATURE_UNIT)
 invariant       POWER_UNIT != null
 invariant       TENSION_UNIT != null
 invariant       MAX_POWER_LEVEL != null && MAX_POWER_LEVEL.getMeasurementUnit().equals(POWER_UNIT) && MAX_POWER_LEVEL.getData() > 0.0
 invariant       TENSION != null && TENSION.getMeasurementUnit().equals(TENSION_UNIT) && TENSION.getData() == 220.0

    Created on : 2026-08-21

    Author:
    Jacques Malenfant
